title: Using Information Governance to Evaluate Patient Care in Amazon's One Medical
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct any benchmark measurement related to faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith. Its focus is on information governance in the context of telehealth and patient care within Amazon's One Medical.
